draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.02, the 2nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 30 at LB. He went 3rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: DeMarcus Ware. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 51 tackles in 2022, 22nd of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 46 career games and 44 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (20 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 20 (100th percentile), tackles for loss 20 (99th percentile), sacks 12.0 (95th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 12.0 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
